description: Cologne/Bonn has three runways: 13L/31R (primary, 3815x60m), 13R/31L (secondary, ~1km SW, 1863x45m) and 06/24 (crossing, 2459x45m). The parallel pair was renamed from 14L/32R and 14R/32L to 13L/31R and 13R/31L on 18-04-2024 (AIRAC 2404) as magnetic heading drifted below the 14/32 band -- dated evidence of magnetic drift (research doc section 2). Headings are TRUE: German METARs report wind relative to true north per a secondhand DWD-brochure citation (research doc section 3); must match the wind-report frame. Parallel-pair true heading (138/318) is from Sprinkle.com (via search snippet; page itself 410'd on direct fetch), consistent with SkyVector's magnetic 136/316 plus current ~3.15-3.2deg E variation. 06/24's true heading (066/246) is DERIVED (magnetic 063/243 plus variation), not independently sourced -- weakest figure here. Not checked against the German AIP. See docs/EDDK_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md.
source: SkyVector (magnetic headings, degree-minute thresholds, lengths/widths), Sprinkle.com (true heading for the parallel pair, via search snippet), OurAirports (confirms current designators), 31-10-2026. Not checked against the German AIP.
